title: Ultimate HUD Mod
description: A minimal HUD mod that shows WASD input, CPS, and movement status in real time for better gameplay awareness and PvP practice.
body:
A simple and lightweight HUD mod that adds useful real-time movement and combat indicators to your Minecraft screen.

This mod displays a clean on-screen overlay showing your WASD key inputs, CPS (clicks per second), and current movement state (walking, sprinting, or sneaking). It’s designed to be minimal, readable, and helpful for PvP, movement practice, or general gameplay awareness.

The HUD updates instantly as you play and helps you track inputs in real time without cluttering your screen.

**Features**
* WASD key display (visual input boxes)
* CPS counter (left-click tracking)
* Sprint / Sneak / Walk indicator
* Clean, minimal HUD layout
* Lightweight and client-side only
